text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: As it happens, I met with an oil tycoon just earlier.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: What in the world could T.M. Opera O be talking about this time? By now, I'm used to her antics, so I get straight to asking for details.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehe, he was quite perturbed, that oil tycoon. Scouting me for his own country, of all things!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed. My prestige appears to have crossed vast oceans.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hah… I was promised a life of luxury should I race in his country.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I refused, of course! The lap of luxury is not what I desire. I only hope for my beauty to bring happiness to the world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That's a scam if I've ever heard one, but there's no problem if she already said no.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, just a few days later…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, if it isn't the oil tycoon!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Out of the blue and flanked by bodyguards, a man who appears to be this oil tycoon appears.

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Opera O! I won't be turned away! Your noble presence will shine brightest on my nation's tracks!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oil Tycoon… That is impossible.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My radiance never dims, no matter the distance! Surely, deep down you know this to be true!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ahh, nevertheless! If you insist on pursuing the Overlord, then…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: We shall have a contest, Oil Tycoon—to remind you of what lies at the core of my beauty!

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: A contest, you say? Very well! Lose, and you will accompany me back to my country!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This offer she's impulsively made goes far beyond ridiculous. I have to make sure she wins somehow.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: However! A contest of speed would be unfair. And an unfair contest is anything but beautiful.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Trainer, give us your recommendation—and make it splendid!
choice_data_list: How about a racing game instead?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Excellent! It's decided. Prepare yourself, Oil Tycoon!

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, T.M. Opera O and the oil tycoon's contest begins at the arcade.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The tycoon is surprisingly good at the game. With perfect technique right off the bat, he calmly cruises to what looks like certain victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But right before he crosses the finish line…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: You raced well, Oil Tycoon.

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Argh! That move you pulled… Were you holding back until the end?

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Lulling me into false confidence… You insult me!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: No! You have it wrong!

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Then why?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oil Tycoon… My brilliance is constant. And at times, it can be blinding to some in the audience.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Thus, I conserve it until the last possible instant, to shine through like rose petals dancing on the wind.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: That the thrilling climax may forever be remembered by my adoring fans!

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: You… You were acting out of concern for the audience?

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: But the people here are few more than my bodyguards. You mean to say this counts as an audience?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Low attendance is no reason to become careless.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My beauty brings joy to one and all. Such is the role of a king—and the Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Hic… sniffle…

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Your beauty rings true, Opera O. It's no different than the day I first became your fan, watching you run across the monitor…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh, Oil Tycoon… I promise you this—though we reside in different countries, my light will reach you all the same.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, without a chance for me to butt in on their wacky exchange, the contest comes to its conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, I come across a headline in the news… "The Oil Tycoon's Secret Vacation."

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Photography… Indeed, a ruler is always being viewed by the public!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Excellent! It's decided. Prepare yourself, Oil Tycoon!

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Challenge accepted!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To ensure a fair contest, they decide to use the self-timer on their phones.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The oil tycoon sits down for all his pictures. Sure, his poses might lack dynamism, but he makes up for it in grandeur and gravitas.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: T.M. Opera O on the other hand…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The sirens forget their song. Lost in my beauty, they weep!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bells resound in chorus to celebrate my brilliance!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: The swans of the lake sing songs of my dazzling presence!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She strikes one animated pose after another, each with someone in mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The selfie session ends, and they each present their best pictures. The result is…

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: I have lost, Opera O.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Dear Oil Tycoon…

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Your consideration for others makes you shine all the brighter in the eyes of those who gaze upon you!

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Your life energy comes across in every medium, be it photo or video! This… This…

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: This is the feeling I had the very first time I saw you dashing across the monitor!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Enough. There is no need to speak further. So long as you understand, that will suffice.

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Oh, Opera O!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I'll send you my pictures. After all, I couldn't allow a fan to return empty-handed after traveling from overseas just to see me.

text_block_list.name: Self-Proclaimed Oil Tycoon
text_block_list.text: Y-you chose this competition so that I might have these souvenirs?! My word… you are the Overlord!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, without a chance for me to butt in on their wacky exchange, the contest comes to its conclusion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, I come across a headline in the news… "The Oil Tycoon's Secret Vacation."
